scope: Project-level developments that materially change how the El Paso–Santa Teresa electrician signal should be interpreted.

signals.title: Oracle sends force-majeure notice while maintaining the 2028 schedule
signals.summary: Oracle sent Project Jupiter's developer a force-majeure notice that could defer payments if the campus misses its 2028 in-service target. Oracle says Project Jupiter remains on its planned schedule, and Blue Owl says the notice does not change the project's financial commitments.
signals.labor_readthrough: This raises execution and timing risk, but it is not evidence of a construction stop. Read any Local 583 decline alongside direct contractor and site evidence.

signals.title: Oracle reports nearly 1,000 New Mexico residents working onsite
signals.summary: Oracle says Project Jupiter is on pace to create more than 7,000 construction jobs and that nearly 1,000 New Mexico residents were already working onsite as of September 8.
signals.labor_readthrough: This is a broad construction-workforce measure, not an electrician count. It provides a useful counterweight to the narrower Local 583 open-call series.

signals.title: Green Chile pipeline in-service target moves to February 1, 2027
signals.summary: Transwestern told federal regulators that the pipeline intended to supply Project Jupiter's planned fuel-cell power system now targets February 1, 2027, nearly six months later than the prior August 15 target.
signals.labor_readthrough: Gas delivery is a critical power dependency and a dated schedule-risk checkpoint. The pipeline slip alone does not establish that current electrical construction has slowed.
